description: This source file implements the factory for creating and managing sessions of a flexible O-DU low component, including session creation, start time calculation, and radio unit configuration, with specific focus on 3GPP specifications and radio interface configurations.

classes.name: split6_flexible_o_du_low_session_factory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating O-DU low sessions and radio units, including start time calculation and configuration validation.

classes.name: split6_flexible_o_du_low_session
classes.description: Represents a session of the flexible O-DU low component, managing its lifecycle and dependencies.

methods.name: calculate_start_time
methods.description: Calculates the start time for a session based on current time, jitter, and window size, ensuring synchronization.

methods.name: create_o_du_low_session
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new O-DU low session based on cell configuration, including radio unit and dependencies.

methods.name: get_du_low_validation_dependencies
methods.description: Retrieves validation configuration for PRACH and preamble based on cell configuration.

methods.name: create_o_du_low
methods.description: Creates an O-DU low component with configuration validation and setup.

methods.name: generate_o_du_ru_config
methods.description: Generates radio unit configuration based on cell configuration and processing delay.

methods.name: get_ru_ofh_validation_dependencies
methods.description: Retrieves validation configuration for RU over fronthaul.

methods.name: get_ru_sdr_validation_dependencies
methods.description: Retrieves validation configuration for RU SDR.

methods.name: derive_srate_MHz_from_bandwith
methods.description: Derives sampling rate in MHz from bandwidth in MHz.

methods.name: create_radio_unit
methods.description: Creates a radio unit, selecting configuration based on parsed config type, updating sampling rate, and start time.
